product.ta-alphatronic-p3.summary: The P3 came with CP/M and the LOGICALC spreadsheet as standard on the twin-drive Alphatronic.
product.ta-alphatronic-p3.history: Triumph-Adler introduced the P3 and P4 in 1982, after the original P1/P2 family. The P3 was the twin-drive office model. The P4 added fixed storage, and the P30 built on the P3 to run 16-bit programs as well.
product.ta-alphatronic-p3.technical.conf: Data disks held 800 KiB. Each side had 80 tracks with five 1,024-byte sectors.
product.ta-alphatronic-p3.technical.veri: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-alphatronic-p3.technical.limi: MOS, character ROMs for two revisions and the keyboard ROM are preserved. Boot remains to be validated. MAME marks the P3 as not working.
product.ta-alphatronic-p3.technical.sour: Es begann mit einem KISS · HNF
